summary: Yatsen Holding Ltd announced the completion of the first tranche of a previously disclosed private placement of RMB-denominated convertible senior notes and warrants, raising an aggregate principal amount equivalent to ~US$120 million. The first tranche closed on May 21, 2026, with Hillhouse joining Trustar Capital and CEO Jinfeng Huang as co-investors in the purchasing vehicle. Proceeds are intended for R&D, supply chain integration, overseas expansion, and M&A. The offering is exempt from SEC registration. Second tranche is expected later this year pending closing conditions. Investors should monitor final terms, conversion mechanics, and potential dilution from the warrants.
